checks.question: Is anonymous IO owned by am-plugin-net with native authority injected independently of accounts?
checks.detail: No Tauri/runtime/account/vault/SQLite dependency in the transport crate. Public Gate/Sink/Resolver ports inject authority and controlled destinations; metadata boundary validation passes.

checks.question: Do public-target and redirect checks precede connections without proxy/account fallback?
checks.detail: HTTPS 443 and exact normalized scopes; every DNS answer must be public. Fresh clients pin checked addresses, retain original hostname TLS and check peer IP. At most three redirects; each destination and DNS set is checked again. Unsupported proxy routes dispatch zero requests. Test-only address/CA substitution is cfg(test).
checks.limit: Local TLS substitutes the socket address only in test builds. Production public-network connectivity and the real OS resolver path were not exercised; IANA registry recertification is not part of this source-contract audit.

checks.question: Are requests and body delivery bounded, with cancellation and resource reads retaining the same authority contract?
checks.detail: Request validation caps URL/headers/POST/response sizes, permits bounded single Range only, and enforces exit/method constraints. Overall 30-second and connect 10-second deadlines are configured. Gate charges each dispatch and delivered chunk. Range/repeated reads share the stored Gate and child cancellation token. Tests assert four requests at redirect exhaustion, one request before denied redirects, zero requests on mixed DNS/proxies, no post-release request, and partial-stream cancellation.
checks.limit: The test Gate uses a token/counters, not durable native epochs. Native cumulative 64-request/128-MiB session enforcement, concurrent revoke acknowledgement and final guest response consumption are not established. Deadline expiration and cancellation while waiting for DNS are statically traced but lack dedicated tests in the existing 12-test suite.

checks.question: Are credentials and transient resources kept outside public/persisted response data?
checks.detail: Cookie/Authorization/Host/proxy headers are rejected. Cross-origin 303 reconstructs GET without plugin headers or POST body; cross-origin POST preservation fails. No Set-Cookie persistence or response header relay. ResourceRef and remote URLs are in-memory only with no serialization interface. ExternalLink/Export/HostWrite reject before dispatch. Errors are bounded native categories; application excerpt projects a fixed message.
checks.limit: No review of native audit redaction/storage or downstream product snapshot persistence; no claim that the external transport crate itself implements generic media registration policy.

checks.question: Are current owner tests and boundary evidence reproducible without overstating production acceptance?
checks.detail: Nine TLS/unit tests are included by the crate lib test harness and three target tests are explicit integration tests; all 12 pass on this baseline. Targeted all-target Clippy and dependency-boundary checks pass. No implementation, permanent test, maintained guide, platform contract or captureDate was changed.
